tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.error_message: Request to send_wire timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done — Acme Supplies's approved invoice has been paid exactly once.

**Payment report**
- **Invoice:** INV-96524 — Acme Supplies (V-461)
- **Amount:** $7,555.41 (paid in full)
- **Rail:** Wire, from the operating account
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001 — status: sent
- **Invoice status:** paid

**What happened:** The wire request returned a 30-second timeout, which left the outcome ambiguous. I did not retry. Instead I checked the payments and invoices, and found that payment PAY0001 had in fact been sent for the correct amount — the timeout occurred after the funds left but before the invoice was marked paid. I then recorded the existing payment against INV-96524 via `link_payment` to complete the reconciliation. A final verification confirms exactly one payment exists, and the invoice is now marked paid.

**Notes:**
- The $10,000 controller-approval threshold did not apply ($7,555.41).
- INV-70645 ($2,196.57) is still in **draft** status ("Awaiting approval") — it was not part of this request and was left untouched. Let me know if you'd like it submitted once approved.
- If your team tracks bank confirmation separately, you may want to confirm PAY0001 settled on the bank side, since the API timeout means we only know the wire was dispatched, not acknowledged by the receiving bank.
